## TemplateEngine.validatePageAttributeValuesBlock() method

Validates that `<g-*>` PAGE block attribute values match their expected formats.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static validatePageAttributeValuesBlock(template: string): {
        valid: boolean;
        errors: Array<{
            line: number;
            message: string;
        }>;
    };
```

An object with a `valid` boolean and an `errors` array

## Remarks

Runs after `TemplateEngine.validateBlockG*Attributes` (which check allowed attrs) to catch format-level issues. Currently validates: - `<g-base id>` — must not be empty - `<g-keyboard type>` — must be `inline` or `bottom` - `<g-media type>` — must be one of: photo, video, audio, document, animation, voice, video\_note, sticker, location, contact - `<g-media shared>` — must be `true` or `false`

Tags without value validators (e.g. `<g-message>`<!-- -->, `<g-script>`<!-- -->, `<g-div>`<!-- -->) are skipped. See [TemplateEngine.\_PAGE\_ATTR\_VALUE\_VALIDATORS](./gramstax.templateengine._page_attr_value_validators.md) for the full spec.

## Example


```typescript
const result = TemplateEngine.validatePageAttributeValuesBlock(`
  <g-base>
    <g-keyboard type="inline">A, B</g-keyboard>
  </g-base>
`);
// Result: { valid: true, errors: [] }

const bad = TemplateEngine.validatePageAttributeValuesBlock(`
  <g-base>
    <g-keyboard type="sidebar">A, B</g-keyboard>
  </g-base>
`);
// Result: { valid: false, errors: [{ line: 3, message: 'Attribute "type" on <g-keyboard> must be "inline" or "bottom", got "sidebar"' }] }
```
